Review of exact PR #4193 head 5934ed6d8e4dc797fb5dbd34a8fc9636b3acdb1c failed two acceptance-critical negative probes although the focused owner suite passed 62 tests. (1) services/source_ingestion/distillation_controller.py:242-277 performs GET then non-conditional POST. A same-id Registry entry approved after the probe but before POST was overwritten from approved to draft; the tick returned success, synced_count=1, and the job became done. Replace this TOCTOU path with an atomic create-if-absent or equivalent conditional Registry write/readback that can never mutate approved or retired state, and add the actual approve-before-POST regression, not only approve-after-write-before-readback. (2) services/source_ingestion/distillation_worker.py:1323-1328 prefers the caller source_records map for versioned jobs. With committed v1 and v2 jobs plus source_records[source_id]=v2, the v1 job was processed with v2 content: job_digest sha256:a164a36d... versus processed digest sha256:03ddc056..., violating committed-snapshot lineage. Versioned jobs must always use the transactionally committed source_for_job snapshot; retain caller-map fallback only for legacy unversioned jobs, and add a two-version regression. Refresh the evidence claims/checksum and request review on the new exact full head.
